"A live key behind a changed platform authenticates fine and hands back success ... The cheapest version is not a full contract test; it is one saved golden response per key and a diff that fails on shape, not on value ... How do you pin the still-the-same-service check without the diff just turning into a test suite that flags every normal change?" [a79a14b9]
